title: $1,000 in Adobe in 2000 is now worth this
caption:
In 2000, Adobe was making Photoshop.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:ADBE:2000-01-03} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Adobe in 2000? 👇
sources: Adobe price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: Say you put in one thousand dollars.
Watch what it turns into. Today, it would be worth about {growth:ADBE:2000-01-03}.
Time in the market does the heavy lifting.
